Overview

Rouen is a city in Normandy with a population of 112,000. The historic capital of Normandy with a magnificent Gothic cathedral, medieval half-timbered streets, and Joan of Arc history. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
